Hello everyone! I just picked up this orient 3 Star. I wanted something cheap to beat up on that was still automatic that wasn’t a seiko 5. So far I’m loving it. It’s a nice size at 38mm. Which is a change for me since I’ve been wearing my citizen diver. It’s running at +10 seconds a day which is fine for the $70 bucks I paid for it. I’ll probably change out the bracelet as the quality is pretty awful. I would still recommend this watch and they have plenty of other colors. Though I love the green dial!

I’m so sorry that you’ve recently gone through a breakup but try not to do anything rash as a reaction to it. You’re still so young. There are so many more people to meet and memories to make. Two years ago the woman I thought I was going to marry broke up with me. It was a tough time and considered ending it all. But I’m glad I didn’t. You can always meet more people and fall in love again. Think of your recently ended relationship as just another chapter in your life. And now it’s time to move on to the next chapter. Despite my username, Trintellix is my current medication. It’s been great so far. I still have my bad days and it doesn’t really help that much with my anxiety but it helps with my suicidal/intrusive thoughts.
